QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Vanished Wind Blessing
QuestInfo.0:
New people have arrived on Identisk Island.
Find out more about these visitors from Grandis.
QuestInfo.1:
New visitors have arrived on Identisk Island.
These Seekers came following traces of an ancient god.
But something's amiss; as soon as they arrived, the Wind Blessing over Tisk vanished.

Talk to #bBaz#k the Seeker for some answers.
QuestInfo.2:
The Wind Blessing over Tisk Island vanished. 
Baz said the Seekers have nothing to do with the situation, and hopes it can be resolved soon...

npc.0: One of the Seekers named #bBaz#k seems to understand you. Go and talk to him.
